mail.subject: Bakery evidence review
mail.body: For everyone’s calendar: the bakery evidence review is Thursday 9 July 2026 at 10:00 Helsinki time. I will prepare the comparison of prepared extracts and a separate environment, including the earlier access decision and setup estimate. Priya will bring updated Acme requirements. The earlier access decision remains in place. Ana
